title: Size of the configuration tableau circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $z$ be a finite binary word. The size of the configuration tableau circuit with $n$ input variables, initial word $z$, and time bound $T$ is $n+2+|z|+W\bigl((T+1)(k(2T+1)+(|z|+n)+3)+1\bigr)$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$ and $W$ is the fixed instruction-block width of the tableau construction for $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet
A natural number of input variables $n$
